moves.name: Toe touch

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan jackknifing up to touch his toes

cues: Jackknife up. Head and butt off the ground.
Picture kneeing yourself in the face.

moves.name: V-sit twist

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan in a V-sit with a medicine ball

cues: Balance on your butt, knees up.
Legs to one side, bounce the ball on the other.
Your legs do the work, not the ball.

moves.name: Spiderman plank

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan pushing up from a forearm plank

cues: Start in a plank on your elbows.
Push up to a push-up position, then back down.
Stay perfectly straight the whole time.

recap.title: Screenshot this.
recap.note: Jog in place 30 s between rounds. New? Do 1 round.
recap.text: Start with no weight. I use a 4 lb ball. Save this for your next ab day.
